About.title: About Bunga Wisata
About.metaDescription: Meet Bunga Wisata (CV. Bunga Wisata Malang), a family-run tour & travel agency in Karangploso, Malang, East Java: group, family, event tours and flights.
About.intro: Bunga Wisata is a family-run tour & travel agency in Karangploso, Malang Regency, East Java. We plan domestic and international trips — from a weekend at Bromo to tours abroad — for small groups, families and large groups alike.
About.story: Our office sits at the Karangjuwet rest area in Karangploso, on the road between Malang and Batu. From there we arrange group tours, school study tours, company gatherings and events, private family tours and flight tickets. Every trip starts with a WhatsApp chat: we ask about your destination, group size, dates and budget, then put together a clear written itinerary showing what is and isn't included. Our customers rate us 4.7 out of 5 on Google, and we want every group to come home with an equally good story.

honest.title: Honest pricing
honest.description: Every package lists what's included and excluded before you pay the deposit — no surprise costs appearing partway through the trip.

personal.title: Personal support
personal.description: Every group, large or small, travels with a tour leader who's one WhatsApp message away — not a rotating cast of customer service numbers.

detail.title: Details handled
detail.description: From tickets and accommodation to attraction entry permits, we handle it all in advance so the only thing left for you to think about is enjoying the trip.
